entities.summary: Lord Shorty (Ras Shorty I) innovated soca music in the 1970s by fusing calypso with Indian rhythms. Trinidad Carnival grew into one of the world's great cultural festivals and inspired diaspora carnivals in Toronto, London (Notting Hill), Brooklyn, and elsewhere.
